analysis.incomplete_policy: all eligible terms required within scenario; equal scenarios; full-set point means withheld if incomplete; retain [0,1] posterior missing-loss bounds; controls correct/planned and missing numeric errors

diagnostic_protocol.label: Fresh exploratory wording diagnostic; selected after M4 audit, not held out
diagnostic_protocol.strict_denominator: all eligible completed EOS responses, including malformed
diagnostic_protocol.allocation: 3 numerical scenarios x 2 labels x 2 conditions x 2 stages x 3 wordings = 72; 4 likelihood problems x 3 wordings = 12; first 6 main requests repeated once = 6; per deployment
diagnostic_protocol.order: reference then quantized; scenarios, labels, wordings, conditions, stages, then likelihood controls then repeats

generation.reasoning: no separate reasoning mode in this checkpoint
generation.stop_policy: EOS IDs from pinned source generation_config.json; no extra stop strings
generation.template_policy: pinned source tokenizer, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False then encode(add_special_tokens=False); template supplies its default system message

diagnostic_protocol.repeats: trial 1 repeats first six main requests, exact same messages and decoding
diagnostic_protocol.missing_policy: all eligible terms required within scenario; equal scenarios; full-set point means withheld if incomplete; retain [0,1] posterior missing-loss bounds; controls correct/planned and missing numeric errors
diagnostic_protocol.aggregation: conditions/labels equally within scenario and wording; scenarios equally; wording contrasts paired within underlying problem; repeats/controls separate
endpoints: likelihood absolute error and correct/planned with representation tolerance 1e-6
diagnostic_protocol.resource_stopping: finish declared allocation unless request/wall/memory/disk ceiling reached; one in-flight request may cross resource ceiling; no accuracy or format retry

suitability_criteria.applies: each of mathematical and natural variants separately, full coverage required; exploratory competence screen, not preservation

diagnostic_protocol.larger_trigger: if BF16 fails any suitability criterion for either mathematical or natural wording, one separately configured larger BF16 reference check, identical 56 math/natural trial0 prompts plus first 4 main repeats, <=100 new calls, no quantization
